notes.title: Oculus Rift DK2 Update
notes.notes:
Into Blue Valley has been updated to work with the new Oculus Rift run time drivers and Windows 10. This brings improved frame rate from the previous version. 

*FYI* Tested only on an Oculus Rift DK2, so the game may not function properly on a DK1.

notes.title: Upgraded to Unity 5
notes.notes:
We have recently upgraded Into Blue Valley to use the new Unity 5 engine, which comes with increased performance and graphics.

A new Oculus Rift version will be coming soon which will fix frame rate and text issues.

Thanks!
